findings.description: The Lambda function embeds a plaintext AWS access key ID and secret access key directly in the environment variables block. Secrets committed to Terraform are stored in state and source control, and are readable by anyone with GetFunctionConfiguration or console access to the function, providing a directly usable credential pair.

The function uses the nodejs12.x runtime, which is deprecated and no longer receives security patches from AWS. Code running on an unmaintained runtime cannot be remediated against newly disclosed Node.js and dependency vulnerabilities.

findings.issue_category: missing encryption of secrets at rest
findings.description: No kms_key_arn is set on the function's environment block, so the embedded credentials are only protected by the AWS-managed default key. Without a customer-managed KMS key there is no control over key policy or audit of who can decrypt these secrets.
